what: Hovering a color-band menu item darkens the whole screen to 30% ink over .25s ease-out (only that item’s text stays above the veil), and a white panel with a thick accent-color border rises from .5rem below over .3s ease-out, its top-edge speech-bubble tail pointing at that item. It stays open when the pointer moves from the item to the panel and disappears at the same length once it leaves both — a mega menu for product sites with many fields and genres

options.delay: Wait before closing after letting go (seconds), default 0 — about .12 if there is a gap on the way over to the panel
options.--fx-dur: Duration of the panel rising (via style), default .3s
options.--fx-veil-dur: Length of the curtain spread (via style), default .25s
options.--fx-veil: Curtain intensity (ink mix ratio, via style), default 30%
options.--fx-rise: Distance the panel is pushed down before it floats up (via style), default .5rem
options.--fx-top: From item top edge to panel top edge (via style), default 100% + tail height
options.--fx-left: From the item’s left edge to the panel’s left edge (via style), default 0 — the original first field is calc(50% - 117px)
options.--fx-tail: From the panel’s left edge to the tail center (via style), default 116px
options.--fx-width: Panel width (via style), default 1000px (750px at 1230px and below is set in the consumer’s css)

note: The curtain is the element’s ::after (position: fixed), so the ::after of an element with the part attached is left empty. On touch devices (no hover) the first press opens the panel and the second press goes to the link. Pressing outside the panel or Esc closes it. The panel look (white panel, 2px accent border, --kf-radius-md) comes from Skin variables
